en: Apply what you have learned so that you can decrease the Health you lose due to the fatigue that results if you fail at a job.
Win the hearts of the crowd with a super sweet performance during a dance battle, causing your opponent's Heat to fall dramatically.
Master what you have learned to dramatically decrease the Health you lose due to the fatigue that results if you fail at a job.
Give an energetic dance battle performance that slightly lowers the Health of your opponents by throwing them off rhythm.
Lower your loss of Health during lessons though efficient movement.
Give a spirited dance battle performance that lowers the health of your opponents by throwing them off rhythm.
Lower your loss of health during lessons even more though efficient movement.
Give a powerful dance battle performance that dramatically lowers the Health of your opponents by throwing them off rhythm.
Lower your loss of health during lessons to the absolute limit though efficient movement.
Boosts the rate the Heat Gauge fills.
This beautiful dance battle move will earn you a lot of bonus points by tracing a rainbow through the air with a showy backflip.
This sublime dance battle move will earn you a ton of bonus points by tracing a rainbow through the air with a showy backflip.
This bold dance battle move will earn you a massive amount of bonus points by tracing a rainbow through the air with a showy backflip.
Boost the number of times you can use Idol Heat during a concert battle.
Perform a costume change in the blink of an eye. <Color:255,255,150,255>Only possible when the Climax Heat Gauge is full.<Color:Default>
Lower the rate at which the second level of Health automatically declines.
Draw a weapon and deliver a lightning-quick strike.
Spin an umbrella and deliver combos, ending with a final, devastating strike.
Forcibly pull a fallen enemy to his feet, then slam him against a wall.
Cruelly shove your enemy back into the wall again after he comes bouncing back.
Knock down your enemy with a vicious strike after he is defenselessly plastered against a wall.
Take your enemy in your arms and throw him over your head.
Viciously slam your knee into your enemy's vitals.
Strike enemies over and over with flashy pole work.
Deliver swift combos with a short-bladed weapon.
Drag your enemy around on the pavement. Road rash is no joke. <Color:255,255,150,255>Only possible when the Climax Heat Gauge is full.<Color:Default>
Your Heat Gauge will rise when you attack with a weapon.
Earn more experience points when you finish off an enemy with a weapon attack.
Your Heat Gauge will rise higher when taunting.
Force a fallen enemy to his feet, then deliver your next attack while still holding him.
Perform Quickstep twice in a row. An impressive dodge.
Slide into your enemy's legs at high speed.
Finish your enemy off after slamming him into a wall with My Meteor Tackle.
Grab an enemy in the middle of a Rush Combo.
Parry your enemy's attack, then transition immediately to a grabbing counterattack.
Break your enemy's guard when you attack with a one-handed weapon, knife, pole, or sword even if he is guarding with a weapon.
Further boost damage to surrounding enemies when hitting them with thrown enemies.
Reduce the amount that the Heat Gauge drops due to My Meteor Tackle.
Stretch the enemy into a shape of a shachihoko, then grab him to deliver another strike.
Pass between your enemy's legs after My Meteor Tackle, then send him flying.
Leap from one enemy while attacking the rest with a sword.
Mercilessly beat your enemy with a tonfa and deliver massive damage with each strike.
Immobilize your enemy with a pole weapon, then use the leverage you have to hurl him away.
Use your mastery of wrestling to perform one grappling move after another.
Violently hurl a long pole like a javelin at a distant enemy.
Tackle your enemy, pushing him back. Can slam enemies into walls. Follow up with <Action:Battle_Normal_Attack@Combat> to knock down or <Action:Battle_Drop_Weapon@Combat> to push away.
Weapon durability increases.
Mow down enemies with a long pole. <Color:255,255,150,255>Only possible when the Climax Heat Gauge is full.<Color:Default>
Grab onto your enemy and do not let go until you deliver numerous blows.
Weapon durability increases even more.
Grab your enemy while evading his attack with Quickstep.
Throw your weapon at the enemy, catch it as it bounces, and repeat. <Color:255,255,150,255>Only possible when the Climax Heat Gauge is full.<Color:Default>
Torment your enemy with a series of thrusts, then finish him off with one more violent thrust.
Mastery of the dolly enables you to use it as a weapon by kicking it toward your enemies.
Mastery of the desk enables you to use it as a weapon by charging at your enemies with its legs facing forward.
